list.title: Agents
list.description: The AI voice agents that answer and make your calls.

empty.title: Create your first agent
empty.description: Start from a template — receptionist, appointment setter, outbound caller — or build one from scratch.

noMatch.title: No agents match
noMatch.active: Try a different search, or check the archived filter.

create.title: New agent
create.description: Start from a template, or build one from scratch.
create.purposeHint: Purpose decides which phone-number slots this agent can fill.

toasts.created: Agent created — publishing to the voice engine…

testCall.title: Test {name}
testCall.description: Type the caller's opening line — the voice engine simulates the whole conversation against the last published version, with tools mocked.
testCall.empty: No test runs yet. Try “Hi, what are your opening hours?”
testCall.placeholder: What does the caller say first?
testCall.simulating: Simulating the conversation — this can take up to a minute…
testCall.unpublished: {error} New agents publish automatically within a minute of their first save.

testTooltip.archived: Restore the agent to test it.
testTooltip.unpublished: The agent publishes to the voice engine after its first save — testing unlocks once that completes.
testTooltip.publishing: A publish is in progress — tests use the last published version.

publishFailed.title: Publish failed
publishFailed.fallback: The voice engine rejected the last publish.
publishFailed.description: {error} We retry automatically every 15 minutes — your changes are safe and go live on the next successful sync.

archivedBanner.title: This agent is archived and read-only.
archivedBanner.description: Restore it to make changes or take calls.

rotateDialog.title: Rotate the tool token?
rotateDialog.description: The old token stops working immediately. The voice engine receives the new one automatically on the next sync — live calls in progress may lose tool access until then.

notFound.title: Agent not found
notFound.description: This agent doesn't exist or was deleted.

toasts.saved: Agent saved — publishing to the voice engine…

general.title: General
general.description: Name, internal notes and what this agent is for.
general.descriptionPlaceholder: Internal note about what this agent handles.
general.purposeHint: Changing purpose affects which phone numbers can use this agent — inbound and outbound slots only accept matching agents.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: How this agent sounds on a call. Tap play to hear a sample.
voice.noVoiceSelected: No voice selected yet — the agent can't take calls without one.
voice.unknownVoiceHint: This voice is no longer offered — pick a replacement.

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.description: What the agent says first, and the instructions it follows.
conversation.firstMessagePlaceholder: Thanks for calling {businessToken}, this is {agentToken} — how can I help?
conversation.firstMessageHint: Spoken as the call connects. Leave empty to let the agent open naturally.
conversation.instructionsPlaceholder: You are {agentToken}, the friendly receptionist for {businessToken}…
conversation.instructionsHint: The agent's personality, rules and job.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Actions the agent can take during a live call.
tools.enableModule: Enable the {module} module to use these tools.
tools.stranded: The {module} module is disabled — this tool will be removed when you save.
tools.lookupInboundNote: Has no effect on inbound agents — a caller's number can belong to someone else, so inbound calls skip the lookup.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: Custom placeholders for your messages. Each one needs a value whenever a call is placed: the default only prefills the place-call form, and campaign recipients without a value are skipped. Variables still referenced in your messages can't be removed until the reference is deleted.

builtins.title: Built-in variables
builtins.description: Filled from the contact record on every call. Tick one to ask for it when placing a call, so the caller can confirm or replace it, and to let campaigns supply it per recipient. Recipients with no value for a ticked variable are skipped.

variables.empty: No custom variables. Built-ins like {businessToken} and {contactToken} are always available.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Booking mechanics for this agent only — anything left on Inherit uses your business and team-member calendar settings.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.description: Who this agent can hand live calls to.

mode.screenedDescription: The AI briefs the person first, then connects the caller.

transfers.noBusinessTargets: No business-wide targets yet — this agent currently has nowhere to transfer calls.
transfers.ownDirectory: This agent uses its own directory and ignores the business-wide one.

customiseDialog.title: Customise transfers for this agent
customiseDialog.description: Once this agent has its own targets, it stops using the business directory entirely.
customiseDialog.copy: Copy the business directory ({count, plural, one {# target} other {# targets}})

switchDialog.title: Switch every target to {mode, select, screened {screened} other {blind}}?
switchDialog.description: This changes how all {count, plural, one {# target} other {# targets}} in this agent's directory transfer.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.last: This is the agent's last custom target — deleting it puts the agent back on the business directory.
deleteDialog.other: This agent will no longer transfer calls here.

revertDialog.title: Revert to the business directory?
revertDialog.description: Deletes all {count, plural, one {# custom target} other {# custom targets}}. Calls will use the business-wide directory again.

toasts.copied: {count, plural, one {Copied # target} other {Copied # targets}} — this agent now uses its own directory.
toasts.reverted: Reverted — this agent uses the business directory again.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.description: What this agent knows about your business. Which entries it can use is managed per entry in your business profile.
knowledge.ragHint: When off, the agent answers from its instructions alone. Entry scoping below still applies when you turn it back on.
knowledge.enabledCount: {enabled, number} of {total, number} enabled for this agent

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.description: Phone numbers that route calls to or from this agent.
numbers.empty: No phone numbers use this agent yet — assign it on the phone numbers page.

callSummary.title: Call summary emails
callSummary.description: After each call, an AI assistant reads the transcript, decides who on your team needs to hear about it, and writes each of them an email tailored to what the call was about.

copy.enabledDescription: When off, nothing is sent — your recipients and rules are kept for when you turn it back on.
copy.recipientsDescription: The people the assistant may write to. It decides who actually hears about each call from your rules and their roles — not everyone gets every call.
copy.customEmailsDescription: Anyone else who should receive summaries, such as a shared inbox.
copy.rulesDescription: Plain-English instructions for who should hear about which calls, what each email should cover, and which calls to skip.
copy.rulesEmpty: No rules yet — the assistant will go by each person's role to decide who needs a call. Add rules to tell it how calls should be routed and written up.

rulePlaceholders.repairs: Send repair and maintenance requests to the property management team at pm@example.com
rulePlaceholders.skip: Skip the summary for wrong numbers and sales calls to us
rulePlaceholders.address: Always include the property address when one is mentioned

sampleTooltip.archived: Restore the agent to send a sample.
sampleTooltip.disabled: Turn on call summary emails and save to send a sample.
sampleTooltip.unsaved: Save your changes first — samples use the saved settings.

toasts.sampleSent: {count, plural, one {Sample email} other {# sample emails}} sent to {email}
toasts.nobody: The assistant decided nobody needed to hear about that call.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Actions that affect this agent's live behaviour.

rotate.description: The tool token authenticates this agent's live actions — bookings, contact lookups — against your account. Rotating invalidates the old token instantly; the voice engine receives the new one automatically.

archive.title: Archive agent
archive.description: Deactivates the agent and hides it from pickers. Nothing is deleted — restore it any time.

restore.title: Restore agent
restore.description: Make the agent active again so it can take calls and be edited.

delete.title: Delete agent
delete.description: Permanently deletes the agent and unpublishes it from the voice engine. Phone numbers that route here are left unassigned.
